user.title: Home Channels
user.description: Use an existing Google Assistant configuration and a dedicated non-admin user with control permission for the display. The gateway token is stored privately in Home Assistant.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Home Channels
reconfigure.description: Enter the complete configuration. Saved secrets are not shown.

error.invalid_configuration: Check the origins, dedicated user's permissions and available media player.
error.cannot_connect: The existing Google integration or fresh gateway channel catalogue is unavailable.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Home Channels adapter is supported.

play_query.name: Play a media query
play_query.description: Find an unambiguous channel or current programme and start it on the configured display using the caller's permission.

query.name: Media query
query.description: A channel name, current programme title, or supported playback phrase. No URLs or receiver overrides are accepted.
